criteria.statement: Pressure thresholds are configurable through Bahia config with safe defaults.
Nostr processor pressure assessment uses configured thresholds rather than hardcoded evaluator defaults.
Dynamic headroom admission requires workload minimum plus reserve and covers workload minimum below, equal to, and above reserve.
Service, LLM, ML, and backup admission scopes preserve reserve when dynamic headroom is requested.
Existing resource-pressure, placement, and admission behavior remains compatible when workers have sufficient reserve headroom.
